summary:
Follow-up to iteration 192. Everything was tested only in isolated, disposable DBs. The customer DB and jeelive.ai were not touched. No AI was used and nothing was deployed. New backend suite tests/override_all_iso193.py: 31/31 passed. It covers confirm-all: anon gets 401/403, reviewer 403, wrong or missing confirm 422, stale revision 409, unknown mock 404, published mock 409 'frozen'. On owner success the message reads 'Warnings cleared…', all 3 coverage_keys are saved with no duplicates, a mock with only soft issues becomes ready with no issues, and a second call stays idempotent. A hard 'missing or conflicting supplied key' issue survives confirm-all. /problems returns total and solution_pages. It also covers the live paper guard. Signed-in Change PIN returns 409 'PIN change works again after that paper ends.' when the deadline is in the future and when the deadline is 0. Forgot PIN 409 has the new 'Forgot PIN works again…' text. After both 409s the old PIN still works and the session is still valid. Change PIN works (200) for an expired deadline, an ended competition, a submitted attempt, a practice attempt, and another student's live paper. Regressions: override_guard_iso192 31/31 (the Change PIN test was inverted to expect 409), forgot_pin_iso184 53/53, typed_delete_iso185 54/54. UI was checked with local Playwright: the public preview frontend with /api routed to the new bridge on 127.0.0.1:8771. Owner at 1920 and at 390: 'Override whole mock' opens the confirm text ('You checked all 3 questions…'). Cancel brings back the button. 'Yes, I checked everything' shows the toast 'Warnings cleared for TEST_X. Rechecking…', and after the recheck the screen says 'Nothing is left to fix' and the button is gone. scrollWidth equals the viewport at 390 and at 1920. Reviewer: the override button is not rendered (count 0). Solution images: none before the details is opened, then 1 loaded (naturalWidth 1144) with no 503. The solution-page issue reads 'Solution page 3: check that the solution picture…'. The ambiguous message is specific to solutions. The held-q--sol-page-

buttons render. Profile Change PIN at 390 shows the 409 live-paper message in the dialog's error box.
critical_code_review_comments: Test harness defect: override_bridge192.py uses a fixed port 8770 and a shared /tmp/uibridge/bridge.json. While other bridges were running (pids 10167, 11392), my first bridge failed to bind, and its finally-block unlinked the shared bridge.json, which may have belonged to another run. I added override_bridge193.py, which uses its own port (BRIDGE_PORT, default 8771) and its own output folder (BRIDGE_OUT, default /tmp/uibridge193). Future bridges should not use fixed shared paths.

Not an app bug: in the bridge, GET /api/my/tests returned 500 with KeyError 'title' (my_tests.history_item uses a['title'], a['exam'], a['started_at']). The cause is the bridge's synthetic attempt, which has no title, exam or started_at. Real attempts always have these fields. history_item could use .get() to be safer, but this is optional.
confirm_all adds every coverage_key, including clean questions. That is harmless. Hard issues stay because of the HARD tuple in rebuild().
seed_data_creation: Only in the isolated DBs, which were dropped after each run. No customer data was changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: cd /app/backend && timeout 280 python tests/override_all_iso193.py. UI: (nohup python tests/override_bridge193.py 2400 > /tmp/bridge193.log &) and wait about 50s for READY, then PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/pw-browsers python tests/ui193.py. The remote browser_automation tool cannot reach 127.0.0.1 or /tmp files, so use local Playwright. The bridge's bridge.json includes a student cookie (a student with a live ranked attempt) for the Profile Change PIN test.
